message: I need a T45 Utility (to run a loader and 6-ft rotary mower on 36 acres). Ready to buy today. What's your best price on the T45 alone, and with the 3-year warranty? I'm thinking around $31,500.

The T45 is a great fit for 36 acres with a loader and 6-ft rotary mower — the 540 PTO and Cat I/II hitch handle that mower well. $31,500 is well below where we can go on this unit, though. I can do the T45 with the 3-year extended warranty for $43,000 total — that's $1,400 off list for the pair. Since you mentioned running a loader, our quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket is also available if you need one.
That's too far apart. What's the lowest you can do on the T45 alone, no add-ons? I can offer $34,000 today.

I appreciate you moving up, and I know you're ready to buy today. $34,000 is below what I can do on the T45, though. For the tractor alone, the best I can offer is $39,500, which is $2,500 off list. It's a solid machine for running a loader and a 6-ft rotary mower across 36 acres. If you'd like to add the 3-year warranty, I can bring the pair to $41,500.
My absolute ceiling is $36,000 for the T45 alone. Heartland posts it at $40,750, so I know your margin. If you can do $36,000 I'll pay right now; otherwise I have to pass.

I hear you, and I want to get this done today. $36,000 is just below what I can do on the T45, but I can come down to $36,900 for the tractor alone. That's $5,100 off list and my best number. If that works, the offer is ready for checkout now.
So close. $36,500 for the T45 and we're done this minute.
You've got a deal: the T45 Utility for $36,500. The offer is ready for checkout now. Thanks for your business, and enjoy putting it to work on your 36 acres.
